title: 镜片、校准与日常维护
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/195_镜片、校准与日常维护.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/195_镜片、校准与日常维护/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一片保护镜片和一支棉签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small round protective lens and a cotton swab, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三十三课：镜片、校准与日常维护。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现火花变弱，想把功率调大
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at weak sparks from a handheld laser welder and reaches toward a blank power setting, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：火花弱了？功率调大！

shots.scene: 小研指着焊枪顶部的镜片仓
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the lens drawer on top of the welding torch, a magnifier icon.
shots.narration: 小研：先看看保护镜片。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a maintenance log and a lint free wipe beside a powered off welder.
shots.narration: 老李：维护好了，设备才用得久。

shots.scene: 先保养焊机，再清洁机架
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two blocks, a handheld laser welder with a lens and a red dot icon, then a cutting frame with a broom icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先保养焊机，再清洁切割机架。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welder and cutting frame switched off and unplugged, a hot nozzle with a clock until cool. No text.
shots.narration: 维护前关机断电，等它冷却。

shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer with an authorised badge adjusts a welder setting while a student watches, a lock icon on a blank menu.
shots.narration: 校准设置由授权人员操作。

shots.scene: 要出光测试，戴防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: laser safety glasses icon beside a test shot icon, a person without glasses crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 需要出光测试，戴好激光防护镜。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a weld spark shrinking with a falling power arrow, a dirty protective lens highlighted inside the torch. No text.
shots.narration: 功率下降、火花变弱，先查镜片。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dirty lens absorbing the beam and heating up, a crack icon. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片脏了会吸收激光、发热烧裂。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean tidy bench away from dust and grinding sparks, a dusty corner crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 到干净少尘的地方操作。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lint free wipe cleaning the outside of a welding torch head. No text.
shots.narration: 先用无尘布把焊枪外面擦净。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: washing hands at a sink, then putting on clean lint free gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 洗手，或戴上无尘手套。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top cover of the torch removed and the lens holder drawn out. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下顶盖，取出保护镜片。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the empty lens port covered immediately, dust falling into an open port crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 仓口马上盖好，别让灰落进光路。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lens held at its edge against a light, a small spot and a burnt mark visible. No text.
shots.narration: 对着光检查镜片。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand gently wiping a small protective lens held by its edge with a cotton swab lightly wetted with alcohol.
shots.narration: 有污点，棉签蘸少量酒精轻擦。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cleaned lens placed back into its holder, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 擦干净了就装回去。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burnt and a badly stained lens going into a bin, a new lens box. No text.
shots.narration: 烧坏了、擦不净的，换新的。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sealing ring and old lens removed from the holder with gloved fingers. No text.
shots.narration: 戴手套取下垫圈和旧镜片。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved fingers taking a new protective lens out of its box by the edge, never touching the glass face.
shots.narration: 手指工具都不碰镜面，沾灰用棉签。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved fingers peeling the film off one side of a new lens and placing it into the holder.
shots.narration: 撕掉一面膜，装进镜片座。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the second film peeled off, the sealing ring fitted back on the lens. No text.
shots.narration: 再撕另一面的膜，装回垫圈。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lens holder pushed back into the torch in the correct direction, the top cover closed. No text.
shots.narration: 按正确方向压回，盖好顶盖。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burnt lens with three cause icons, spatter, reflected light and low shielding gas. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片烧坏，查飞溅、反射和保护气。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a log entry and a message to the equipment manager icon. No text.
shots.narration: 原因记下来，报告负责人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clear round red dot with a check, a blurred broken red dot with a stop icon. No text.
shots.narration: 红点模糊残缺，没装好，不能出光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the red aiming dot beside the filler wire tip instead of on it, an original welding nozzle fitted. No text.
shots.narration: 嘴装好了，红点仍偏在丝旁。

shots.scene: 管理员权限，负责人操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps a blank settings screen with a lock icon while students stand aside.
shots.narration: 进管理员设置，由负责人操作。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: left and right arrow icons moving the red dot sideways onto the wire. No text.
shots.narration: 点左右箭头，移动红点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the red dot centred on the wire tip, a done check icon. No text.
shots.narration: 红点中心落到焊丝上，点完成。

shots.scene: 切割嘴孔小，光会打内壁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small cutting nozzle with the beam hitting its inner wall, blockage and reflection icons. No text.
shots.narration: 切割嘴孔小，光可能打到内壁。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: left right adjustment first, then the offset reset to zero icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先调左右，不行就把偏移归零。

shots.scene: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰就停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hex key in the adjustment hole on the torch turned slowly until a sharp red dot appears. No text.
shots.narration: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰就停。

shots.scene: 焊枪架在支架上，只开红光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the torch fixed in its holder pointing at a plate, only the red aiming light on, the laser enable switched off. No text.
shots.narration: 焊枪固定在支架上，只开定位红光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nozzle glowing and discoloured with smoke, a stop and power off icon. No text.
shots.narration: 喷嘴发烫变色冒烟，立即停机。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank settings screen with a focus scale icon, a note pad recording a reference mark. No text.
shots.narration: 先在系统设置里查焦距参考值。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the power switched off, the screen dark. No text.
shots.narration: 调整前，关闭设备电源。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers opening a clamp on a powered off welding torch and sliding the scale tube to a reference mark.
shots.narration: 不一致就开卡扣，推拉到参考值。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sharp focused spot versus a large blurred spot with spatter and scattered rays. No text.
shots.narration: 焦点不准，焊不透，散射也多。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the clamp closed firmly on the scale tube, a loose clamp drifting crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 调好卡扣一定合紧，免得跑焦。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropped torch on the floor, then a lens check, a focus check and a report icon. No text.
shots.narration: 焊枪摔碰过，先查镜片再校准。

shots.scene: 振动补偿：机器自动完成
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laptop with blank design software connected to a closed cutting frame, a start button and a vibration wave being smoothed. No text.
shots.narration: 连软件按开始，机器自动振动补偿。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the frame lid closed while the head moves, a hand reaching inside crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 补偿时机器会动，关盖手别伸进。

shots.scene: 两台关机，调焦点固定件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: both machines powered off, the welding head taken out and its bracket set to a scale mark and tightened. No text.
shots.narration: 两台关机，按提示调焦点固定件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alignment sticker placed on the bed, then the lid closed. No text.
shots.narration: 贴好对位贴纸，关上机盖。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single test mark on the sticker compared with the red dot, laser safety glasses icon outside the closed lid. No text.
shots.narration: 授权人员单次出光，看是否居中。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: left right screws and front back buttons adjusting until the red dot sits in the centre of the mark. No text.
shots.narration: 左右拧螺丝、前后按键，调到居中。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot nozzle with heat waves and a heat resistant glove icon. No text.
shots.narration: 刚加工完，喷嘴可能很烫。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand in a heat resistant glove unscrewing a cooled nozzle from a powered off torch and wiping it clean.
shots.narration: 戴耐热手套拧下来，擦干净。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bottom tray of the cutting frame pulled out, sand and slag poured into a metal bin. No text.
shots.narration: 拉出底板，倒出沙和熔渣。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the tray wiped, fresh sand added and the tray pushed back. No text.
shots.narration: 擦净底板，加沙推回。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands lifting out a slat from the grid bed of a powered off cutting frame and scraping slag off its teeth.
shots.narration: 取出栅条磨掉熔渣，齿口平整装回。

shots.scene: 清洁剂喷在布上擦镜头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cleaner sprayed onto a cloth first, then the cloth wiping a small camera lens, spraying directly crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 清洁剂喷在布上，再擦摄像头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light strip wiped inside the frame, the lid viewing window wiped on both sides. No text.
shots.narration: 擦净灯条，观察窗里外都擦。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fixture rails and dust shields wiped free of dust and slag. No text.
shots.narration: 夹具导轨和防尘板，擦去灰渣。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the exhaust fan removed from the frame and its plug disconnected. No text.
shots.narration: 取下排风扇，先拔开插头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: screws removed, the fan housing and the guard grille taken off. No text.
shots.narration: 拆螺丝，取下外壳和网罩。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a brush sweeping dust off the blades of an unplugged exhaust fan, then a cloth wiping them.
shots.narration: 刷掉扇叶积尘，再用布擦净。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the guard and housing reassembled as before, the plug reconnected and the fan refitted. No text.
shots.narration: 按原样装好，接线装回。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rear panel and both side panels of a powered off frame removed. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下后板和左右侧板。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the tray slide rails wiped clean, the tray sliding smoothly. No text.
shots.narration: 擦净滑轨，推拉才顺。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand running along the torch cable, a frayed, flattened cable with exposed spring crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 线缆破皮压扁，要停用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: compressed air passing a dryer and a filter, water drained from the filter bowl, oily wet air dirtying a lens crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 压缩空气要干燥过滤，定期排水。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger lightly tapping a blank touch screen, a screwdriver tip poking the screen crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 触摸屏手指轻点，不用尖物戳。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance log with date, lens, calibration and cleaning icons and a signature line. No text.
shots.narration: 维护校准，写进维护记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fault tag hung on the welder and a call to the equipment manager. No text.
shots.narration: 发现异常挂牌停用，报负责人。

shots.scene: 镜片：洁净处，擦或换，不碰镜面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean bench, a swab, a new lens held by its edge. No text.
shots.narration: 镜片在洁净处擦或换，不碰镜面。

shots.scene: 校准由授权人员，先看红光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lock icon on settings, a clear red dot and a focus scale. No text.
shots.narration: 校准由授权人员做，先看红光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: power off, a cooled nozzle, a fan and a log book. No text.
shots.narration: 清洁前断电冷却，做好记录。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着防静电腕带和相机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds an antistatic wrist strap and a phone camera beside a powered off welder, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：焊机部件更换（一）：通用流程与电源部件。
